title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs with Flatbread
description: A traditional Saudi dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection served with warm flatbread. This recipe is perfect for a flavorful and satisfying meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Arabian Kissed Sauce, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the chopped lamb to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Grill the lamb for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
7. Meanwhile, warm the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F for 5 minutes.
8. Serve the lamb kebabs with the warm flatbread and additional Arabian Kissed Sauce, if desired.
